title: Productos y materias primas
goal: Read a country-by-country tour of what each Latin American economy exported in the late nineteenth century, including the 1876 refrigeration breakthrough that let Argentina start exporting meat.

items: Explain what Brazil built around its coffee production.
State what Chile found in nitrates after the War of the Pacific.
Explain what the ship Le Frigorifique made possible starting in 1876.
Name the product that began to define Central America late in the century.
Use relative clauses with que, donde and cuyo to pack detail into a sentence.
